notes.content:
The 2nd Season of VR Master League (VRML) is starting on February 20, and today we have more information of what that entails when it comes to prizes and information!

VRML Prizes

 Regions: NA & EU
 Prizes: $1500, Banners & Merch!
 Finals: June 3 & 4

Season 2 Overview
If you haven't heard of VRML previously, it's a competitions organization run for and by the community of competitive VR games such as Blaston. We've partnered with them to bring you an official league for the game with it's 2nd season starting on February 20.

Once Season 2 starts, players will play in one of the two available regions, and have at least one match per week against opponents where they can rank up on the regional ladder. After 11 weeks, the top players in each region will be invited to a playoff bracket played over weekends, where the top 2 players will win a trip to play in the live finals held at VRML Con in Denver, Colorado on June 3 & 4.

All players who participate in the league will get the VRML Season 2 Banner, while finalists and the winners will get more  exclusive version of the banner.

So test your luck and compete in Blaston! We wish you all good luck and hope you have fun in Season 2 of VRML!

notes.title: Blaston: Free-To-Play Patch is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we have released a patch for Blaston to address some issues introduced in version 2.0 of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/f71883f3546c14fdfd80df899fe24104916da2d8.png

These mainly focus on critical issues found where players were unable to see their equipped avatar skins in the Ozo Lounge as well as text not being displayed properly for players playing Blaston in Italian & Traditional Chinese.

In version 2.0 we had hoped to add more localization options for players, but unfortunately we ran into issues when adding Italian and Traditional Chinese to the game. For the time being these options will become unavailable, and we hope to be able to add them into the game in a future update.

Bug Fixes
 Avatar skins are now properly displayed when entering the Ozo Lounge.
 Updated and fixed several text errors in weapon and attachment descriptions.
 Disabled broken unsupported languages: Italian & Traditional Chinese.


For players on standalone Quest 1, unfortunately it seems like the game is having trouble running the game with all the new content added in. We’re currently investigating this issue to see what we can do to solve the problem.

If you’re running the game on Quest 1, we recommend you restart the headset, and avoid entering the Ozo Lounge for now. You should still be able to play duels normally while we investigate this further. For Quest 1 players on Steam, you should still be able to play the game as per usual.

notes.title: The Blaston: Free To Play Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XpMd7DqeWzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Blaston is now a Free-To-Play game! Welcome to the Free-To-Play Update, we have a lot of things that we included in the game which brings the version number to 2.0! We hope you’re as excited as we are about what’s ahead for the game. Read the highlights below, or check out the patch notes list further down for a quicker overview.

Blaston is now Free-To-Play!
On Steam and Meta Quest, Blaston is now a free to play title. This means that you no longer need to purchase the game to get in on the action. Let your friends know and start playing today!

Golden Gratitude Reward
We’re incredibly thankful for everyone that has supported Blaston so far, it’s you who have allowed us to get to this point and have kept the game alive. As a thank you for believing in us, and purchasing the game before it went free to play - you will all recieve the Golden Gratitude Reward. This includes the Golden Gratitude skin for Clamos & the Viper Ellipse, as well as a x1 Wall of Blasts (1160 Blasts) for free! Explore the new store and pick out something special with your new chunk of change. This skin pack will first be available for our veteran supporters, and will be available at a later point in the store for everyone else.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/39f193f212cb7d146e2cf77c6cadf428aa638a2b.png

Blaston is coming to Pico!
Blaston is not only going free to play on Steam and Meta Quest, as the game will be available on Pico 3 & 4 devices starting early 2023. We’re currently finishing up the final pieces, but soon you’ll all be able to join the action from 3 VR platforms!

New Legendary Skin Set: Dynasty
The Dynasty Bots guard VIPs within the Premium version of the Paracosm. Made for high impact and high performance to take any and all threats down. You can now find the Dynasty skin for both the Octo Agent, and the Wildcat.

New Legendary Podium: Bliss
Show your true allegiance to the game with this newly animated podium which sports the “NEVER. STAY. STILL.” slogan!

New Avatar & Weapon Skins:
Aside from the legendary skins, we have a ton of skins for both avatars and weapons. You’ll be able to find them in the newly remodeled store in the main menu. Enjoy!

New Attachments: Majestic, Supermajestic, Majestic Nade, Avalanche Nade, Swarm, Tundra, Nova Nade, Lance Rapide
We’ve added 3 attachments each for 8 more weapons in this update including all of the enercage weapons, but also the special weapons Swarm & Tundra as well as the Nova Nade and Lance Rapide. We’re hoping to bring back enercages into the mix and reintroduce the area denial tools for you to use.

New Movement System:
We’ve completely reworked the movement system (Inverse Kinematics) for the avatars in the game to be more realistic and follow your natural body movements. For advanced users of Blaston this means that you’ll now have to move as you would in real life to dodge and avoid incoming projectiles. Our main reasonings for this huge change is to continue to promote movement in the game, lessen any confusion as to why you got hit and also avoid having players doing unnatural movements that could lead to injuries. This will take some time for veteran players to get used to, but we hope you look forward to using the new system.

New Features in the Blaston Spectator:
The free to use Blaston Spectator has now been updated to 2.0 with a few new additions to optimize use for continued tournament use. We’ve tweaked the in-game UI, added localization to the client, a camera speed option along with a freecam mode. To fully capture some cinematic shots you can now also toggle the UI in-game with the “U” button.

Game Updates:
 Blaston is now Free-To-Play on Meta Quest & Steam.
 Remodeled the Store in the Main Menu.
 Remodeled the Customization screen in the Main Menu.
 Added new avatar & weapon skins to the store.
 Added a new podium to the store.
 Added attachments for: Majestic, Supermajestic, Majestic Nade, Avalanche Nade, Swarm, Tundra, Nova Nade, Lance Rapide.
 Updated and balanced the weapons in the game.
 Improved the Passthrough Mode on Quest 2
 Added Color Passthrough Mode on Quest Pro.
 Updated the game movement system (Inverse Kinematics).
 Added several new loadouts to the Arctic Blast game mode.
Weapon Updates & Balancing:
 Hammer Attachment 2: Increased collision damage from 14 to 15.
 Hammer Attachment 3: Reduced projectile speed slightly.
 Hammer Ellipse Attachment 3: Decreased damage.
 Hurricane Attachment 1: Reduced player damage from 14 to 10.
 Hurricane Attachment 2: Reduced ammo by 1.
 Lance: Reduced damage per second.
 Lance Attachment 1: Reduced laser projectile duration by 0.5s, reduced damage per second.
 Lance Attachment 3: Reduced damage per second.
 Lance Rapide: Reduced damage per second.
 Luma: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
 Luma Attachment 1: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
 Luma Attachment 2: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
 Luma Attachment 3: Reload increased from 0.3s to 0.5s.
 Nova Attachment 1: Increased projectile speed from 0.7 to 1.
 Nova Hurricane: Decreased the strength of gravity of projectiles, now acts more like the regular Hurricane. 
 Raptor Attachment 1: Increased player damage from 5 to 6.
 Viper Attachment 2: Player damage decreased from 25 to 20, added +1 projectile bounce, reduced speed.
 Wildcat Attachment 1: Reduced burst of projectiles.
 Wildcat Attachment 2: Decreased projectile spread, increased collision damage to 8.
Attachment Additions:
 Avalanche Nade Attachment 1: Fewer but faster projectiles
 Avalanche Nade Attachment 2: Less projectiles with a tighter spread.
 Avalanche Nade Attachment 3: Delayed fire on projectiles with larger spread.
 Lance Rapide Attachment 1: Increased damage per second with a reduced duration.
 Lance Rapide Attachment 2: Increased collision but heavily reduced player damage.
 Lance Rapide Attachment 3: 4 shots with increased damage per second but reduced duration
 Majestic Attachment 1: Decreases projectile size and duration, but increases speed and damage.
 Majestic Attachment 2: Decreases reload time, and duration, but increases damage.
 Majestic Attachment 3: Less ammo, but splits the projectile.
 Majestic Nade Attachment 1: Less duration and damage, but splits the projectile.
 Majestic Nade Attachment 2: Enercage travels further but with reduced damage per second.
 Majestic Nade Attachment 3: Continuously moves and more damage.
 Nova Nade Attachment 1: Increased projectile speed, but less damage.
 Nova Nade Attachment 2: Less damage, but splits the projectile.
 Nova Nade Attachment 3: Higher player damage, but less speed and health.
 Super Majestic Attachment 1: Enercage now floats up after being fired.
 Super Majestic Attachment 2: Higher damage, but less duration.

 Swarm Attachment 1: Nodes pause duration decreased, with less damage.

 Tundra Attachment 1: Increased projectile speed, with reduced damage.
 Tundra Attachment 2: Decreased cooldown and blinding duration, but increased damage.
 Tundra Attachment 3: Split projectiles with reduced ammo and reduced damage.
Ranked Changes:
 Players above the Platinum rank have now had their rank reset to Platinum.
Other Updates:
 Adjusted the single player campaign to be easier for new players to take on. 
 Added a social contract for when entering the Ozo Lounge the first time. Remember that you can block and mute someone if someone misbehaves which will remove them from your social area.
 Adjusted the menu position when accessing the tools loadout to be more to the left, allowing players to more easily practice ellipse weapons from the left.
 Prices of legendary items have been adjusted.
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the Hurricane Attachment 1 would display incorrect player damage numbers.
Blaston Spectator:
 Added localization support.
 Added localization option in settings.
 Added a camera speed option in settings.
 Added a freecam mode option in settings.
 Added a UI toggle accessed with “U”.
 Optimized In-Game UI.

Thank you for supporting Blaston to allow us to get to this point!

Keep in mind that if you’d like to suggest something for the game, we have the Blaston suggestion board specifically for this! While we can’t promise any changes, posting here helps us understand what the community would like to see in Blaston.

Of course, if you’d like to meet and discuss the game with us and others, then you can also join the Blaston Reddit and the Blaston Discord!

To keep yourself updated on the game, we suggest you also follow us on Twitter & Facebook!

If you're interested in competing in Blaston you can follow our official partner VRML on Twitter & Twitch.

- The Blaston Team

Have you missed us? We haven't posted a roadmap for the game in a while, but we're finally ready to talk a bit more about the next update for Blaston.

With the Glow Up update now out for a few months alongside the Blaston Championship, we've gathered a ton of learnings when it comes to the state of the game and what type of content that you as a player value. In our next update we're going to focus on these key areas, while also making the game more accessible than ever.

Currently Planned Content & Events:
 ✨ Tons of new attachments
 🔫 Weapon balance changes
 👑 Ranked improvements
 🏪 Store Improvements
 👶 Onboarding improvements
 🎨  More content & skins
By now you've come to expect new attachments with updates, and this will not slow down with our next update. With the extended period that we've had, we've also been able to see the meta change and stabilize which will make it easier for us to decide on how to move forward when adding more of them as well as balancing the weapons overall.

With the attachments and balance changes, we'll also continue to introduce more options for players to be able to show off their styles within the game.

Since launch almost 2 years ago, we've seen Blaston evolve and change together with the community, and what we had in mind when we built the original has also evolved. We've noted several core parts in the game that we would like to dive deeper into which are the ranked system and the store. We're still in the process of looking into this, so we're not ready to share more just yet, but expect some improvements here.

Overall we're hoping to make this the best version of Blaston yet, balance wise, but also introduction wise for new players to get into and stick with the game. To be able to reach this goal we're currently aiming the update for later this year to be the final update of Blaston of 2022. Once we get closer to the update we’ll share more details on the parts mentioned above.

Until then we hope that you're enjoying the Blaston Championship! Coming up we have the Last Chance Qualifiers with sign-ups opening up shortly after Phase 1 ends. notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/5edba2669caa4e58d4a52f64c39a267f4bf90802.png

We’re BACK! And we have a bunch of content added to the game for you. In the Glow Up update, we’ve included several new skins, avatars, a new arena - along with new attachments and weapon balancing - and the launch of the Blaston Championship!

New Legendary Skin: Lyxx
Lyxx has always been the face of Blaston, and today we’re switching it up by giving her a new look with a legendary demonic skin. With a more aggressive look, we see this as an alter ego to the main character that you know and love!

New Avatars: Clamos & Argentia
A little over a year ago we launched the singleplayer campaign for the game, and we know you want to be able to become the characters that you face. So we polished the models and made them av	ailable to be played. Get them in the store now.

New Arena: Greatstone Valley
Similarly to the campaign characters, a lot of people expressed how they missed playing Quick Draw when it fell out of the seasonal mode. Well, now you’ll at least be able to go halfway there with a classic version of Greatstone Valley.

New Attachments: Ellipse Weapons, Vector, Nova Helix, Nova Hurricane, & Lance Nade
Last update, we brought a new element into the meta with several attachments including bouncing projectiles. This time we’re shifting our focus to the original ellipse weapons, along with weapons we felt like needed some love with the Vector, Nova Helix, Nova Hurricane & Lance Nade. You can now track and complete the attachment missions for these to find new ways to play with them!

New Tournament Circuit: Blaston Championship 2022
Alongside the Glow Up update, we’re launching our first ever competitive circuit for Blaston! If you’ve ever wanted to try competition in the game, now’s your chance. The circuit is divided into 3 phases, with the first starting this August. Players can join by playing the ranked mode, joining the weekly Blastzone Challenges, or participating in community tournaments to fight for their lion share of a total of $11,000 prize pool! Read more on the official webpage at: resolutiongames.com/blaston/championship

Blaston Championship Cosmetics: Banners & Universal Weapon Skin
With the launch of the Blaston Championship, we’re adding a few more cosmetics to the game so that you can fully get into the competitive spirit. You’ll now see the Blaston Championship logo in the arenas, and you can also represent your region with the European or North American banners available in the store. Exclusive finalist and winner banners will also be given out to the participants who qualify and win the regional finals. notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update is live!
notes.content:
It’s time to get down to brass tacks, because the Blaston Reloaded Update is finally here! Version 1.15 brings the long awaited first batch of weapon attachments to the game, a new seasonal mode “Street Brawl”, and our first collaboration weapon item “The Cyber Bow”.

And that’s not all, we’ve continued to work on quality of life features for the game as well, along with some new rewards and legendary skins for weapons and avatars! This is probably our biggest update to date, so gear up, get ready, and load into Blaston Reloaded!

New Weapon Feature: Weapon Attachments
We’ve now added weapon attachments to the game. We’re starting with 10 weapons to make sure that we maintain the balance of the overall weapons in the game. In the first batch we’re including 3 attachments to the following weapons: Raptor, Nova, Wildcat, Hammer, Viper, Lance, Hammer Nade, Frostbyte, Hurricane and Luma.

Attachments are unlocked by the new mastery system, select a weapon in the loadout and press “track” to begin the mastery. Complete the missions to unlock the attachments one by one, then equip them to change the behavior of the weapon!

New Seasonal Game Mode: Street Brawl
It’s time to take things to the streets, the Scrappers’ Street to be more specific! In the new seasonal game mode, duelists play in long distance duels using The Cyber Bow and a modified Nova to take each other down. Who’s the best dodger and marksman? Settle the score with a Street Brawl!

New Weapon: Luma
Introducing the first two-handed weapon to the world of Blaston is the Luma! This is a sharpshooter bow and arrow where duelists will have to give up an extra hand for some extreme damage output!

The Blaston Spectator will be available for free on Steam on May 5th
Soon after this update, we’re releasing the Blaston Spectator on Steam for free! This is a separate version of Blaston where you can spectate matches on a PC. This is mainly built for content creators and tournament organizers, but anyone can try it out and watch their matches from new camera angles including third person and first person views!

New Weapon Skins: The Karnivore, The Mallet & The Cyber Bow
Take charge with the new legendary versions of the Hammer Ellipse and Raptor Ellipse. The Mallet replaces the Hammer Ellipse and represents a darker more feared version, as it dons the b0yk0t logo on the side. Joining it is the Karnivore, which like the Deadringer, represents a look reminding players of the past worlds of Blaston. Both of them are now available in the store for all players.

The collaboration item skin for the Luma, from Apex Construct, The Cyber Bow is now here in Blaston. It’s unknown how the item first appeared in the world of Blaston, it’s assumed a glitch in the system may have brought it forth from another virtual world. Try it out in the Street Brawl seasonal mode, and get it for free in the store within the release week of the Blaston Reloaded Update. Along with the the collaboration, we also have a bundle to get both Blaston and Apex Construct! Get the bundle here!

New Legendary Avatar Skin: Bunny Hax
The hologram face upgrade is no longer unique to Shoxx! The newest skin for Hax, Bunny Hax, gives the avatar this feature as well along with some very tall bunny ears.

New Cosmetics: Blaston VR Master League Platform & Banner
We have partnered up with VR Master League (VRML) to bring you the first official esports league of Blaston, built together with the community. Get the VRML banners in the store, or get them by signing up to Blaston VRML Season 1: vrml.com/blaston

New Arena: Scrappers’ Street
Some fights are just not meant to be displayed in fancy arenas, some fights you settle in the streets. Now you’re able to challenge others in the Scrappers’ Street arena by purchasing it in the store!

Graphical Improvements
We’ve taken some time to look into the performance and visuals of the game, and it has paid off! You’ll notice that the locker room in the main menu has been cleaned up, but we’ve also made sure to optimize the textures of the game, along with making improvements to banners. We’ve also changed filtering settings for the game which will make it look a bit clearer. For players on Quest devices, we’ve also made some improvements in the passthrough mode by adding particles and fixing some color issues.

Community Request: Ping Indicator
We’ve heard the calls from the community, you want to get a better understanding of the quality of the matches. We’ve responded to this by introducing a ping indicator to the match interface to allow players to identify the quality and stability of their connection to the match. Our hope is that this will give players an idea if they need to improve things on their end, and also for tournament organizers to more properly host competitive events.

Community Request: Wait for an opponent
Many players have told us that they would like to still be able to access the main menu and loadout while waiting for a match. Now players are able to do so by going into the duel settings, and select “Wait for an opponent”. Enabling this option allows players to check their loadout and practice combos on the dummy bot before heading into a match.

Game Updates
 New seasonal game mode added: Street Brawl
 New weapon added: Luma
 New legendary skins added to: Raptor Ellipse, Hammer Ellipse
 New legendary avatar skin added: Bunny Hax
 New cosmetics added: VRML Platform & Banner
 New arena added: Scrappers’ Street

notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update Devlog #2 - Quality Of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Hi there Blasters! Today we wanted to give you a sneak peak at some of the things we're adding to the Blaston: Reloaded Update! In this one we're taking a look at Quality of Life Improvements! Watch the video below to get the information, or read the text version here below.

[previewyoutube=FA1tRimjaQI;full][/previewyoutube]

Campaign Updates
Starting off, this one is for new players and the lore fans out there, we’re taking another look at the singleplayer campaign and making some adjustments to it. Players will now have a larger set of weapons to get to know the game with, and we’re making the battles a bit more interactive with bots reacting more like they would in regular matches. We’ve also removed some unwanted missions forcing players to go to the Ozo Lounge, and added some improvements to the final boss fight.

Mastery System
For veteran players of Blaston, you may have everything unlocked, but for this one we wanted to continue to improve the introduction of the game for new players. Previously when you started the game, you unlocked weapons simply by leveling up. This was pretty arbitrary as you didn’t really know what was coming ahead of time, and you suddenly got new tools to use and had to figure it out by yourself.

With the new Mastery system, players will instead have the ability to track weapons to unlock them with weapon missions. At level 5, 10 and 15, new weapons will be available to be tracked. Players can go to the loadout to start tracking them and then complete the missions by playing the game. We’re hoping that this gives you a better start to the game where you learn things bit by bit.

Weapon Attachments
This however leads to the new feature that you’re all waiting for, which are weapon attachments. When you’ve completed the weapon missions, weapons with attachments will have a new set of objectives for you to clear. The attachment missions will give you a chance to dig deeper into the mechanics of the weapon and learn it, before you expand on its mechanics.

Attachments give the player new possibilities to customize their loadout by altering the mechanics of the weapon, so be sure to check it out when Blaston: Reloaded releases.

Graphics Optimization
As previously mentioned we’ve taken a thorough look at the game to see where we could improve and optimize the game. What will be most noticeable when you play the new update is that everything has a more clear and crisp look. This is because on a dev side we’ve gone through and improved how all the UI and how it's loaded in. The textures and player banners have all also been optimized from one of our technical artists, which should stabilize the framerate of the game on all platforms, so more smooth gameplay woho!

More Tweaks
Finally, we’ve added some more tweaks that we think you’ll enjoy as well. Mission rewards in the next update will give you Blasts as rewards, but with the introduction of Legendary weapons and skins being added to the store. So if you missed out on those rewards previously, you’ll have your chance to get them in the next update. 

For the ranked mode, we’ve added a cooldown at the end and start of seasons to negate issues that some players had with their rank not being reset properly. We’re also adding the ability for players to make friendly lobbies with all seasonal modes. So now you can return to Quick Draw or Arctic Blast, whenever you like. We’ve also looked into fixing VFX for weapons and have been able to add a few news ones as well.

Get ready for the next update…
With this we think you’re a bit more prepared for the gigantic update we have coming along for you, as we haven’t even shown you all the fixes or the new content yet. Now know you’re begging for the question of the release date of Blaston: Reloaded, and we will be posting that shortly, so make sure to follow us on Twitter and join the Blaston Discord to be the first to know when it happens.

We’re hitting you with a one-two punch of updates this month, and before the Blaston Reloaded update, we’re releasing the Blaston Redacted update! We’ve added a lot of community requested features and balancing to get you ready before all the attachments are added to the game.

New Feature: Machine Learning Bots
We heard you, you want more difficult bots. We’ll you’re in for a treat, because we turned on machine learning on them, and to our surprise, these bots have gotten way out of control. In this new seasonal mode, players share a single platform and have no weapons but their fists and passionate spirit. The mode takes place in the Scrapper’s Street, and is perfect as a conclusion for your Discord trash talk.

It’s time for us to be true to our community and include this into the patch notes. We’re documenting this from now on and we’ve moved the platforms 0.00000001 milimetres further away from each other for optimal gameplay.

New Feature: Lena Everywhere System
Lena has gone rogue and will now start to appear where you least expect it, the main menu. In the crowd of matches, private Ozo Lounge lobbies, perhaps even in your living room. If she gets close enough to you, she will steal all of your tokens.
 	
New Weapon: Pebble
You’ve mastered the FrostByte, now welcoming the Pebble! This little nasty rock has high projectile collision, will daze you on hit and may remind you of some horrible memories from elementary school.

New Collaboration Weapon: Holy Hand Grenade
When we said “hit the mark” we weren’t fooling around. We’re bringing a classic to the world of Blaston. This nade has all of the nade components combined into a single weapon. This one has a 20 second cooldown, but upon detonation fires the Hammer, Nova, Majestic, Lance, Avalanche nade effects.

New Feature: Steve the intern
We’ve recruited a new member to the team, Steve! Steve will hang out in the Ozo lounge at all times of the day to make you feel at home and also give you some life advice should you need it.  Queueing up for ranked now sends players into a dark void without any UI or music where they can reflect on their mistakes.

Weapon Updates
 Cortex Shield: Is now as wide as the platform that you stand on.
 Aegis Shield: Increased health to 1000, decreased size by 90%.
 Quicksilver: Doubled the boost speed, is now activated by grabbing with both hands.
 Tundra: Hitting a player with a Tundra projectile will now freeze the opponents game to make them crash and give you an instant win.
 Nova Helix: Reverted balance to the release version of the weapon.
 Vandal: Cloud projectile now destroys held weapons.

 Gave the bartender a Hammer which is used on players whenever a glass is thrown their way. Players hit by the hammer will be sent back to the main menu.
 On Fridays, Ozo the bear will now appear in the Disco to DJ some banging beats.

Ranked Changes

 Doing inappropriate gestures after a match now makes players lose extra LP.

Bug Fixes
 Fixed server boosting so that it now only affects players with high speed internet connection.
 Fixed a bug that allowed your high score in the Zombies on the Dance Floor arcade machine to give you an edge in duels.

notes.title: Blaston: Reloaded Update Devlog #1 - Community Requested Features
notes.content:
Hi there Blasters! Today we wanted to share some information on the upcoming Blaston update, Blaston: Reloaded (scheduled for April), in our first devlog video with our Community Manager! Watch the video below to get the information, or read the text version here below.

[previewyoutube=ue8izk4Qwnw;full][/previewyoutube]

Earlier this year we talked briefly about it in our roadmap video, and we’re finally getting close. While everything isn’t really ready to be shown just yet, we wanted to let you in and update you on some of the features that we’ve been working on, that have been requested by the community. So strap in because we’re about to go super nerdy on this one.

Requested Feature: Waiting for an Opponent
We know a lot of people have been asking for the ability to interact with the main menu while queuing. In the update, we’re adding this and calling it “Wait for an Opponent”. When this is enabled, you’ll still be able to interact with the store and your loadout, and practice those ellipse curves while you’re at it.

Requested Feature: Ranked & Bot Changes
Late last year we introduced rank decay and no more League points gained by bots. While this did make for a more competitive format, we felt in hindsight that we were removing the “Never Stay Still” aspect as we made facing bots less attractive. In the new update, we’re bringing bot rewards back, but slightly more balanced. We’re also looking into improving the bots a bit, and making them a bit more challenging for those in the Overlord league.

Requested Features: Match Ping Indicators
Another visual change that is coming in Blaston Reloaded is the introduction of Ping Indicators. These are shown by the health bars during matches, and let you know the status of both you and your opponents’ network connection to the match. We hope that this will allow you to more easily identify your own issues when they arise during matches. We’re also hoping that this will make it easier for online tournament organizers to run their tournaments.

Requested Features: Projectile Speeds
Finally, in the Blaston: Reloaded update, we’re changing all weapon projectiles to have a linear travel speed, instead of an initial burst that slows down. Currently in the game, and how it’s been since launch, projectiles are shot out from the weapon with a burst of speed to then slow down when traveling towards your opponent. We also played the game a lot in good conditions.

As you know, we didn’t anticipate Blaston to become so competitive focused at release, and with a lot of things going online the last few years, we’ve come to see the drawbacks of having this cool looking burst in suboptimal network conditions. During those times, it sometimes appears as projectiles are spawning further ahead when players experience lag.

So what does this change mean? Well with this change, hopefully you’ll have a more smooth experience when playing Blaston - and projectiles won’t appear to pop out unexpectedly as much anymore.

In the next devlog

Overall, besides all of the exciting new content we have planned for this update, we’re taking a thorough look at Blaston from the ground up, to give you the best possible experience when playing. In the next dev log, we’ll take a closer look at Quality of Life improvements that we’ve added to the game since December.

We hope that you’re excited as we are for Blaston: Reloaded, and we'll see you in the next devlog!

Follow us for more updates!

notes.title: What's next for Blaston in 2022!
notes.content:
Hello blasters!

Check out the video featuring our community manager, or read about the update below!

[previewyoutube=avh1SK-Sz7w;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t been keeping tabs on the title so far, will quickly recap what we’ve added to the game since launch, then we’ll get into what we’re working on in 2022.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/230686d4638ded346d9b17b958588f0dce19c050.png

Blaston Updates Recap
Since the launch of the game we've added:

 7 Weapons
 Avatars & Skins
 Social Hub with 2 Floors
 Single Player Campaign
 Private Tournaments Mode
 Replays & Spectator
 Seasonal Modes
 In-Game Challenges
Blaston Price Change & Sale
With our most recent update, we believe that we’ve hit a new benchmark of what Blaston is. The game has grown exponentially since its launch. Thanks to the feedback of our community and the creativity of our development team, new features have turned Blaston into so much more than it was on day one — and we believe we’ve reached a point where the price should reflect that. Starting January 17th, we’ll be increasing the price of Blaston to $19.99.

With that said, starting today at 10 AM PST up until Sunday 10 AM PST we're running a 20% discount on Steam for everyone who's been on the fence about getting the game, but if you'd like to support us and the games future then you can get it later as well!

Next Blaston Update
In April we’ll be launching Blaston Reloaded, a major update that completely reinvents your arsenal with the addition of weapon attachments. Players can mix and match modifications to customize their weapons for the first time, making your loadout uniquely yours.

Blaston Reloaded will also see the release of graphics enhancements on high-end VR devices, a new seasonal mode, and the introduction of an all-new weapon type that’s being developed as our first collaboration with another game studio. We’re not ready to say who, but VR gamers can expect a weapon they already know and love. We think it will really hit the mark. Expect more details in the coming months.

As for the next update following Blaston Reloaded, expect a release later this summer. 

Other Updates
Besides game updates, we're continuing work on our spectator client for Blaston, and talking with several esports organizers to host more tournaments for the game. We want to give our players more opportunities to bring their talents to tournaments and competitions. If you're a tournament organizer, or if you're interested in growing the competitive scene for Blaston, please reach out to us on the Blaston Discord. Otherwise, please stay tuned for updates by following us on the Blaston Twitter or Blaston Facebook page.

Thanks again for joining us on our journey. We have plenty of new ways to play on the horizon, and even more ideas in store for what comes next. We’ll see you in the arenas.

The Ozo Lounge has opened up a new floor, welcome to Knockout! Here up to 8 players will be able to host and organize single elimination tournaments to find out who’s the best player in the room! notes.title: Blaston: Quick Draw Update is live! - New game mode, weapon, character & more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CoApSCuDsgY;full][/previewyoutube]

Howdy Blasters, it’s time to step on up and try out the new Seasonal Mode for Blaston, Quick Draw! In version 1.13 we’ve added plenty of new things for you to try out! Check them out in the list below for more information!

New Game Mode: Quick Draw
You can now play in the seasonal mode queue! The first seasonal mode we’re introducing is Quick Draw! Face off in the Greatstone Valley, far away from the city you know and love, and duel each other in old school fashion! Both players play using the Deadringer, a legendary skin for the Raptor which in this mode is sped up to replicate a more realistic cowboy duel! When the bell rings, the quickest one to draw and shoot your opponent will be deemed the victor!

New Rewards: Taylock & Deadringer
Finish the missions and collect the premium rewards that you get to try out in the Quick Draw mode! Play as the newest character Taylock, who represents the TrueTech faction along with the Legendary Raptor skin, the Deadringer.

New Weapon: Swarm
The Blaston arsenal keeps growing with the newly added Swarm weapon! This is the first weapon with multiple firing modes utilized by charging up the weapon when holding down the trigger. Set up for some flashy combos using this charged up blue hand cannon!

Balance Update
We’ve made a complete overhaul of the weapons to promote more varied play at both high and low levels. Amongst the changes we’ve focused on the usage of “Drop Blocking”, where players drop weapons to block projectiles. This is a skillful mechanic which we intentionally designed. However, we’ve now seen the full strength of it, and in this update we’ve altered the HP of most weapons in regards to their cooldown and size to balance the use of this technique and for other uses.

notes.title: Blaston Crackdown Update is live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/c92aeb2d7a8a9d514a540f8c9884a1b616ec25e2.png

The Blaston Crackdown Update is now live!

It’s time to get back into Blaston with the biggest update yet! The world of Blaston has grown, and with it, new challengers have appeared to take down the duelists! In this update we’re introducing:

A new single-player campaign: The Octopresence have invaded the underground world of Blaston dueling with Octo Agents. Some duelists have reportedly been hacked by an unknown entity called ModOps. It’s time to take them on and find out more about why and who is behind it all!

New battle arena: Finish the campaign and unlock the new arena Scrapper’s Market in the store to battle opponents in a new environment.

New avatar & skins: Play through the campaign and unlock the ModOps skins in the store! We’ve also added the Octo Agent and the legendary Viper Ellipse as Mission Rewards.

Upgraded Ozo Lounge: The social space for Blaston has been upgraded and expanded! There are now Tokens to be used in the Ozo Lounge to play improved versions of the arcade game Alien Blast (now called Super Alien Blast), and a jukebox has been added to Disco 99!

bHaptics Integration for Oculus: Want to fully experience the rush of playing Blaston? Well, now you can by using bHaptics vests. Now you can wear one while playing Blaston on Oculus, and take your gameplay to the next level. Pinpoint where you get hit and get more instant feedback during your matches!

Game Updates

 New single-player campaign added: The Crackdown
 New battle arena added: Scrapper’s Market
 Mission Reward added: Octo Agent
 Mission Reward added: Legendary Viper Ellipse
 Story Reward added: ModOps Skins for Dracx, Scrofax, Squillax & Taurex
 Oculus bHaptics support & integration implemented
 Added player warnings: Players who break rules or our code of conduct will now first get a warning before any subsequent bans are given out
 Added connection warning when the player network is unstable
 Added UI Improvements to the mission screen


Weapon Updates

 All weapon projectiles collision detection has been improved. 
 Nova: Reload time has been reduced 1.5s to 1s.
 Viper Ellipse: Speed increased from 2.85 to 3, Ammo reduced from 4 to 3, spawn cost reduced from 7s to 6s.
 Viper: Reload time decreased from 2s to 1.5s.
 Quicksilver: Damage taken on early break reduced from 10HP to 5HP.
 Hammer: Reload time decreased from 1s to 0.5s.
 Raptor: Ammo increased from 5 to 6, Damage decreased from 10 to 8.
 Frostbyte: Max throw speed reduced from 4.8 to 4.5
 Vandal: Cloud reduced in size


Ozo Lounge Updates

 Ozo Lounge Tokens added
 Character “Lena” added to the Back Alley
 Jukebox added to the Disco 99 floor
 Upgraded the arcade game “Super Alien Blast”
 Remote grabbing of objects added
 Tutorial added to the Back Alley


Bug Fixes

 Fixed most instances where projectiles would pass through other objects.*
 Fixed issue where projectiles damaged players twice.
 Fixed issue where the profile icon didn’t match the avatar in the match.
 Fixed unlocked tool items showed locked icons when owned.
 General performance optimizations.
 Oculus party voice is now prioritized over in-game voice in friendly matches.
 Improved the hitbox of the Frostbyte.
 Fixed issue where the Frostbyte would collide with projectiles twice.
 Fixed issue where there would be a lag at the end of a replay.


* = There can still be cases if a shield is moved rapidly, the projectiles may pass through. If you notice any instances of this we urge you to please report it! 
 
Make sure to join the Blaston Community on Discord and follow us on Twitter for future updates!
 
See you out there in the arenas!
 
The Blaston Team

Salutations, Blasters! We’re happy to be back with the first update of the year and we’ve got some good stuff packed into this one, including new game mode, an upcoming tournament mode, character skins and more!
